brief:
Shehab Wire documented severe impacts of the Israeli war on reproductive health among Gaza's women, citing UN data and testimonies from patients and physicians. The report details rising miscarriage rates, fetal loss, and increased birth defects, alongside deteriorating prenatal care amid displacement conditions.

Pregnant women face compounded risks delivering in displacement tents while unable to access proper medical monitoring. The crisis compounds existing health system collapse, forcing mothers to navigate pregnancy and childbirth without stable shelter or adequate clinical support.

title: Israeli war devastates Gaza women's reproductive health, Shehab reports
